summary: Replaced unsupported tasks with cited booklet questions that ask students to construct primitives from given derivatives, including sums, negative powers and expanded products, and removed three unasked recognition or explanation items while retaining the tier minima. Preserved the accepted zero-derivative practice item and theory facts, updated the procedure to match the repaired tasks, and checked every replacement answer and quiz distractor.
reviewSummary: All 24 final items have correct answers, usable working and supported booklet question types; every quiz has exactly one correct option and accurate distractor explanations. The theory follows the booklet, no worked examples were supplied, and all three removals are justified with tier minimums preserved.
